title: Breakout Squad
description: Lead a 3D tactical squad down action-packed city streets, multiply troops through power gates, upgrade weapons, and blast through enemy barricades.
controls: Drag left and right to steer your squad through bonus gates and fire automatically at incoming enemies and bosses.

zh-CN.title: 激战突围
zh-CN.description: 3D 都市小队突围射击跑酷：左右滑屏穿越增益门扩充火力小队、升级武器，横扫沿途敌军与关底 Boss。
zh-CN.controls: 按住并左右拖动控制小队走位，自动开火射击敌人，优先穿过增益大门壮大队伍与火力。
